Worker/protocol import survey (main sources). No scalaslurm.* leftovers.

(A) move into sojourn-worker (M2):
- slurm4s.worker: ScalaTask, TaskContext, TaskRegistration, TaskRegistry (WorkerBridge)
- slurm4s.worker: FileResultPublisher, FileTaskContext, FileTaskWorkspace, FileWorkerEventSink, WorkerRunResult, WorkerRuntime (SojournEntryPoint)
- slurm4s.protocol: TaskInvocationCodec (SojournEntryPoint)

(B) already in remote-exec-kernel (keep depending downward):
- AtomicFiles, ByteLimit, ContentDigest, Diagnostic(s), SchemaId, SubmissionKey, WorkerRelease*, ValidationFailure, OperationId/Version, RetrySafety, Failure*, Freshness, InputCodec/ResultCodec, AttemptEpoch/Id, …

(C) stay slurm4s-only (sojourn-slurm / launch path):
- slurm4s.worker: PreparedRegisteredSubmission, RegisteredTaskLauncher, WorkerLaunchSettings, FileTaskContext (SlurmSite batch submit)
- plus core/managed/local/ssh scheduler APIs

Conclusion: no new sibling worker repo; surface is small and Program-shaped → in-repo sojourn-worker (decision 2A).
